name: root-crate-cache-split
body: The `cache` module is organized as `src/cache/manifest.rs`, `src/cache/fragment.rs`, and `src/cache/factstore.rs` under `src/cache/mod.rs`, which holds the module declarations, the re-exports, and the file-level `#![allow(dead_code)]`. The module FQN `rust.apg.cache` anchors the submodules, and the test module is `rust.apg.cache.tests`. The free function `rebase` is `rust.apg.cache.fragment.rebase`, the `implemented-by` target of `solution.component.scan-driver`.
